in_sanskrit.name: Arjil
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the Thunderbolt
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Arjil एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Arjil is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Indra', the Hindu god of rain and thunder. This name is believed to bring the power and strength of Indra to the one who bears it. Arjil is a revered name in Hindu culture, symbolizing the divine power of nature and the courage of its bearer.
